entity_raw.definition_raw:
You make deadly strikes when magic cloaks your location.

Prerequisite(s): Blind-Fight, Improved Initiative.

Benefit(s): Whenever you attack from total concealment provided by a magical source (such as the displacement or invisibility spells), the first attack roll you make each round that is a critical threat is automatically confirmed as a critical hit.
